abstract: In contrast to the cytogenetically well characterized testicular germ cell tumors (GCT) in adults, reports on cytogenetic studies in pediatric GCT are scarce. The presence of an i(12p) and numerical abnormalities involving chromosome 12 are the most frequent cytogenetic changes in GCT of adults. We have performed in situ hybridization (ISH) studies on paraffin sections and on isolated nuclei of 13 pediatric GCT with particular emphasis on those chromosome abnormalities that are common in adult GCT. These include numerical and structural abnormalities of chromosomes 1 and 12 as well as numerical deviations of chromosomes 8, 10, X, and Y. The histological subsets of the tumors investigated included two dysgerminomas (DGE), one seminoma (SE), two embryonal carcinomas (EC), four mixed and two pure yolk sac tumors (YST), and one undifferentiated (IT) and one differentiated teratoma (TD). Similar to the GCT in adults, additional copies of chromosome 12 were the most frequently observed numerical abnormalities. In contrast to the findings in adult GCT, changes in the size of the pericentromeric hybridization signals of chromosome 12, suggesting the presence of i(12p) chromosomes, were found in only two cases. No chromosome abnormalities were found in the pure TD or in the TD cells of mixed tumors containing a YST component. In the YST portion, however, Ip deletions and/or numerical chromosome changes were present. Surprisingly, deletions of the short arm of chromosome I, del(I)(p36.3), were frequent in pediatric GCT and were the sole abnormality detected in two cases. The Ip36 deletions were present in all stage-IV EC and YST investigated and were absent in the relatively benign TD and in one YST stage-I. Therefore, Ip36 deletions may have value as a prognostic marker in pediatric GCT.
abstract_ja: 成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)は細胞遺伝学的に詳しく解析されているが、小児の胚細胞腫瘍に関する細胞遺伝学的研究は少ない。成人のGCTでよく見られるi(12p)および12番染色体の数的異常は、最も頻度の高い細胞遺伝学的変化である。我々は、成人GCTで一般的な1番および12番染色体の数的・構造的異常、ならびにX・Y・8・10番染色体の数的異常を対象に、小児GCT 13例についてパラフィン切片および単離核でin situハイブリダイゼーション(ISH)を行った。組織型の内訳は、ディスジャーミノーマ2例、セミノーマ1例、胎児性癌2例、混合型卵黄嚢腫瘍4例、純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、未熟奇形腫1例、分化型奇形腫1例であった。成人GCTと同様に、12番染色体の追加コピーが最も頻繁な数的異常であった。しかし成人GCTとは異なり、i(12p)を示唆する動原体周辺シグナルのサイズ変化は2例にしか認められなかった。純粋型分化型奇形腫および卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を含む混合腫瘍の奇形腫成分には染色体異常は認められなかった。一方、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分では1p欠失および/または数的変化が認められた。意外にも、短腕の欠失del(1)(p36.3)が小児GCTで高頻度に見られ、2例では唯一の異常であった。1p36欠失は病期IVの胎児性癌および卵黄嚢腫瘍の全例に認められ、比較的良性の分化型奇形腫および病期Iの卵黄嚢腫瘍1例には認められなかった。したがって1p36欠失は、小児GCTの予後マーカーとしての価値を有する可能性がある。
